mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 380000) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 380000, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), higher interest rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high employment level (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 130000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110) indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 110, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 11700) indicates an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both INDPRO < 110 and GDPC1 < 11700, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During an early-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 380000), rising consumer demand drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 380000, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
